thought.text: Now let me create the deployment `.env` file with sensible local values.

reasoning_content:
I need a proper Fernet key (32 url-safe base64-encoded bytes). openssl rand -base64 32 gives 32 bytes base64 = 44 chars. Fernet key must be 32 bytes base64urlencoded => 44 chars. `openssl rand -base64 32` produces exactly that format (with possible +/=). Fernet accepts standard base64 with padding. Good.

Let me create the .env file for the dev Compose method. The .env file in deployment/ is loaded by compose automatically, and also by Django settings via load_dotenv. But in containers, env vars are passed explicitly.

Let me create deployment/.env based on dev compose defaults.

Field encryption key: use openssl rand -base64 32 result. Let me use the first one.

Let me write the .env.

action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment && cat > .env <<'EOF'
# ===== Django =====
DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=nXhCh5JHdFAFzn7vJU1HbXGpEa9KwKT3YsrxNuGHepflrgm3eLlKuch932Ft
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=api.localhost,admin.localhost,qgis.localhost,tiles.localhost,files.localhost,app.localhost,localhost,127.0.0.1,backend,nginx,caddy
DEBUG=True
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://api.localhost,https://app.localhost,https://admin.localhost,https://files.localhost,https://qgis.localhost
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://app.localhost

# ===== Database =====
DB_NAME=qonnectra
DB_USER=qonnectra_user
DB_PASSWORD=local_dev_db_password_123
DB_HOST=db
DB_PORT=5432

# QGIS DB user
QGIS_DB_USER=qgis_user
QGIS_DB_PASSWORD=local_dev_qgis_password_123
QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME=qonnectra

# ===== Spatial =====
DEFAULT_SRID=25832

# ===== Django superuser =====
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_USERNAME=admin
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_EMAIL=admin@example.com
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=AdminLocalPassw0rd!

# ===== Cookies =====
USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE=True
COOKIE_DOMAIN=.localhost

# ===== Field encryption =====
FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY=wiFRPkULj3ckWNAVLKqCfJRcVTQq8c0mWcFgQlkiVEY=

# ===== Domains =====
DOMAIN_NAME=localhost
API_DOMAIN=api.localhost
APP_DOMAIN=app.localhost
FILES_DOMAIN=files.localhost
QGIS_DOMAIN=qgis.localhost
ADMIN_DOMAIN=admin.localhost
TILE_SERVER_DOMAIN=tiles.localhost

# ===== Frontend API =====
API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/
PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/
PUBLIC_TILE_SERVER_URL=https://tiles.localhost
PUBLIC_DOCUMENTATION_URL=https://qonnectra.de/manual/

# ===== Ports =====
DB_EXTERNAL_PORT=5440
BACKEND_PORT=8000
QGIS_SERVER_PORT=8082
CADDY_PORT=80
CADDY_HTTPS_PORT=443
EOF
echo "written"; wc -l .env
